verdict.rationale: The pack shows only a Cloud Cost Management doc title (cloud spend visibility) and general Monitors that could alert on spikes. Nothing shows that Datadog's own observability usage and spend can be seen, attributed to teams or services, or alerted on before billing. One community report cites a lack of billing transparency, which lowers confidence, though it is not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: documented visibility into observability or Datadog usage spend, attribution of cost to teams or services by tag, usage-spike or bill-forecast alerting, and independent hands-on corroboration.
